title: TraceAnalysisResponse
description:
Deep call understanding produced by the Amigo intelligence pipeline.

Analyzes the raw call audio to identify emotional dynamics, key decision
moments, and actionable coaching - understanding that exceeds what either
participant had during the call itself.

**Latency note**: This endpoint reads from the analytics data warehouse.
Expect 500ms-2s response time, not sub-10ms like transactional endpoints.

call_sid.title: Call Sid
call_sid.description: Call identifier (Twilio call SID or direct session ID)

status.title: Status
status.description: ready: analysis complete. pending: call completed, analysis processing. unavailable: analysis not possible for this call.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: 2-3 sentence narrative of the call - the emotional story, not just what happened

key_moment_count.title: Key Moment Count
key_moment_count.description: Number of key decision moments identified (typically 3-8)

key_moments.title: Key Moments
key_moments.description: Key decision points with causal attribution to audio inputs

emotional_arc.title: Emotional Arc
emotional_arc.description: Caller emotional trajectory as a readable sequence (e.g. 'curious -> confused -> frustrated -> relieved')

emotional_shifts.title: Emotional Shifts
emotional_shifts.description: Critical emotional state changes detected in the caller's voice

coaching.title: Coaching
coaching.description: Specific, actionable agent improvements tied to exact moments in this call

counterfactuals.title: Counterfactuals
counterfactuals.description: Alternative actions that would have meaningfully changed the outcome

deep_understanding.title: Deep Understanding
deep_understanding.description: Synthesis of why this call went the way it did - combining audio perception with execution data

signal_response_alignment.title: Signal Response Alignment
signal_response_alignment.description: Per-signal alignment analysis: whether the agent's response matched each salient signal

missed_opportunities.title: Missed Opportunities
missed_opportunities.description: Moments where the agent could have taken a better action

emergent_patterns.title: Emergent Patterns
emergent_patterns.description: Cross-call or cross-turn patterns detected by the analysis

call_entity_id.title: Call Entity Id
call_entity_id.description: UUID string of the associated world.entities_synced call row (if resolved)

computed_at.title: Computed At
computed_at.description: When the analysis was produced by the pipeline

moment_timestamp.title: Moment Timestamp
moment_timestamp.description: Position in the recording this coaching applies to (seconds)

observation.title: Observation
observation.description: What was observed in the audio at this moment

recommendation.title: Recommendation
recommendation.description: Specific improvement the agent should make

expected_impact.title: Expected Impact
expected_impact.description: How this improvement would change the interaction

CoachingItem.title: CoachingItem
CoachingItem.description: A specific, actionable improvement tied to an exact moment in the call.

timestamp_seconds.title: Timestamp Seconds
timestamp_seconds.description: When the alternative action was available (seconds)

alternative.title: Alternative
alternative.description: What it could have done instead

predicted_impact.title: Predicted Impact
predicted_impact.description: How the call would have gone differently

Counterfactual.title: Counterfactual
Counterfactual.description: An alternative action that would have meaningfully changed the call outcome.

factor.title: Factor
factor.description: What specifically drove this decision - exact words heard or tone described

DecisionFactor.title: DecisionFactor
DecisionFactor.description: A specific audio input that drove an agent decision.

timestamp_seconds.title: Timestamp Seconds
timestamp_seconds.description: When the shift occurred (seconds from start)

trigger.title: Trigger

agent_awareness.title: Agent Awareness
agent_awareness.description: Whether the agent noticed and responded to this shift

EmotionalShift.title: EmotionalShift
EmotionalShift.description: A critical emotional state change detected in the caller's voice.

turn_taking_quality.title: Turn Taking Quality
turn_taking_quality.description: How well speakers managed turn-taking - interruptions, overlaps, pacing

information_density.title: Information Density
information_density.description: Whether the agent gave too much or too little information per turn

repair_effectiveness.title: Repair Effectiveness
repair_effectiveness.description: How misunderstandings were detected and resolved

rapport_trajectory.title: Rapport Trajectory
rapport_trajectory.description: How the interpersonal dynamic evolved across the call

InteractionDynamics.title: InteractionDynamics
InteractionDynamics.description: System-level analysis of the conversation as a whole.

signal.title: Signal

agent_response.title: Agent Response
agent_response.description: What the agent did in response

alignment.title: Alignment

insight.title: Insight
insight.description: Short insight on why the alignment went the way it did

SignalResponseAlignment.title: SignalResponseAlignment
SignalResponseAlignment.description: Whether the agent's response aligned with a salient signal in the call.

timestamp_seconds.title: Timestamp Seconds
timestamp_seconds.description: Approximate position in the recording (seconds from start)

what_happened.title: What Happened

reasoning.title: Reasoning

decision_factors.title: Decision Factors

alternative.title: Alternative

TraceKeyMoment.title: TraceKeyMoment
